name: SponsorshipDeliverablesTracker
tagline: Contracts, deliverables, proof of performance and make-goods for every sponsor – one plug-and-play Power Platform app.
description: A complete sponsorship-fulfilment app: a value-at-risk dashboard, a deliverables grid with status rules and bulk actions, sponsor scorecards with POP recaps, a due-date calendar and a proof-of-performance queue – with demo data, low-code column mapping and Power Fx events.
features: Fulfilment engine: delivered ÷ contracted per deliverable, value-weighted fulfilment per sponsor, type and programme; earned value counts Delivered, Proof submitted and Verified items.
Value at risk: the unfulfilled share of the value of every overdue, missed or short-delivered deliverable – the number sponsorship teams are asked for in renewal and make-good talks.

Status workflow with business rules: Planned → Scheduled (needs a due date) → Delivered (needs a delivered quantity) → Proof submitted (needs a proof reference) → Verified (needs proof when Proof required is on, and a note when delivered below contract); Missed needs a reason; Missed → Make-good → Scheduled/Delivered; Verified can be re-opened.
Make-goods: one click on a missed deliverable turns it into a make-good due in 14 days with an audit note; undo is available.
Proof-of-performance queue with checklist and approve/reject, and a per-sponsor POP recap text for renewal decks and sponsor reports (PopReportText output).
Health flags: Overdue, Due soon (configurable window), Missed, Short-delivered and Complete – shown in the list, calendar, detail and dashboard.
Bulk actions: Schedule, Proof submitted, Verify, Missed – each deliverable is checked against the rules and skipped items are reported.
Confirmation before destructive actions (Missed, Delete) and undo for status changes, make-goods, edits, deletes and bulk actions.

Search across deliverable, sponsor, contract, type, property, owner, notes, proof and status; sort by due date, value, sponsor, status, fulfilment or title; group by sponsor, type, property or status; CSV export of the filtered list.

Low-code configuration: programme title, currency symbol, reference date, due-soon window, proof required, deliverable types, properties/events, accent and status colours, view labels, start view – text, numbers and yes/no only.
Demo mode with 28 fictional deliverables for six sponsors across a festival, a football season, a marathon, a TV show and a radio breakfast show – every view works the moment the control is dropped.
Phone layout with a bottom view switcher, cards, compact calendar, full-screen detail and filters; tested at 1366, 860, 375, 360 and 320 px.
Keyboard: 1–5 switch views, / search, N new deliverable, Enter opens, Space selects a row, Alt+←/→ back/forward, Esc closes.
